svg.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.text: # Pipeline template: security checks (DevSecOps). Owned by the platform team,
# with the rules of the security team.
# Use it: copy this file, unchanged, into your service's repository as
# It runs on every pull request, so a dangerous change is stopped before anyone
# merges it, and from the Actions tab (security-checks → Run Workflow).
# SAST (semgrep) reads the code without running it and fails on a line that
# matches one of the security team's rules (below).
# CVE scan checks the libraries the service lists (requirements.txt, ...)
# (trivy) against the public list of known weaknesses, and fails on a
# HIGH or CRITICAL one that already has a fix.
# Both checks always run, so one red run shows everything that needs fixing.
